shortBulletSummary: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index is at 22, indicating "Extreme Fear" among investors.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced substantial outflows for the seventh consecutive day, with BlackRock's IBIT seeing its second-largest single-day outflow.
Ethereum's price fell below $2,000 for the first time since March 2026, with trading volume confirming the downward move.
Middle East tensions (US-Iran strikes) are fueling inflation concerns and a "higher-for-longer" Fed stance, driving institutional de-risking from crypto.
Bit Digital acquired $20 million worth of Ethereum (8,568 ETH), reinforcing its strategic asset position in the ecosystem.
